title: The equivariant Milnor-Witt motive of $\overline{\mathcal{M}}_{1,2}$
summary: We provide a decomposition of the equivariant Milnor-Witt motive for the moduli space of stable curves $\overline{\mathcal{M}}_{1,2}$. As a result, the equivariant Chow-Witt ring $\widetilde{CH}^*(\overline{\mathcal{M}}_{1,2})$ is fully determined.
